an5.113:1.1: “Bhikkhus, a bhikkhu who has five qualities can’t enter and dwell in right concentration.
an5.113:1.3: It’s when a bhikkhu can’t endure sights, sounds, smells, tastes, and touches.
an5.113:1.4: A bhikkhu who possesses these five qualities can’t enter and dwell in right concentration.
an5.113:2.1: A bhikkhu who has five qualities can enter and dwell in right concentration.
an5.113:2.3: It’s when a bhikkhu can endure sights, sounds, smells, tastes, and touches.
an5.113:2.4: A bhikkhu who possesses these five qualities can enter and dwell in right concentration.”
